text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Mubarak and King Hassan agree to hold a meeting of the Jerusalem Committee as soon as possible.
- Mubarak says Israel must stop all settlement plans in Arab East Jerusalem.

- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri to hold two important meetings today. The first meeting will discuss new investments and include 15 ministers, the central bank governor and the head of the Capital Market Authority. The second meeting will deal with cooperation ties with China.
- Ganzouri to meet with 15 ministers and review the economy in an important meeting today. He is due to leave for China in April.

- Cabinet Affairs Minister Talaat Hammad clarifies certain aspects of the rent law approved by parliament on Thursday, says that it includes a clause which allows the tenant to pass on lease to their heirs until death if they practice the same business.
- Three terrorists killed 14 citizens and injured 6 in Nag Hammadi.
